verdict.rationale: Datalab's own docs say its core engines Chandra, Marker, and Surya "remain free open source," and Marker has a public GitHub repo under datalab-to that community users have run directly. The hosted platform itself (API, pipelines, Forge, on-prem containers) is presented as a paid, Enterprise-gated product with no source availability shown. Missing for 10: a named license (e.g., which OSI license and any commercial-use restrictions), evidence that the hosted platform/SDK source is open, and independent confirmation of licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
